hints.title: Sorting Advantage
hints.text: If a group of k students is selected, it is always optimal to pick the k students with the smallest requirements.

hints.title: Happiness Conditions
hints.text: For a sorted array nums, selecting the first k students is valid if and only if nums[k - 1] < k and nums[k] > k.

hints.title: Boundary Cases
hints.text: Check k = 0 (valid if nums[0] > 0) and k = n (valid if nums[n - 1] < n).

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting nums followed by a single linear pass.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space beyond in-place sort.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sort and check greedy prefix happiness conditions.
